frozen.plants: #703's plants (pade_second_zero.ZMain, pade_second_set.make_plant), zero at ZLOC, main c_m refitted; the second set's density s^P (1-s)^alpha on the segment from Q - L Q/|Q| to Q; nothing else changed
frozen.positions: Q = P0 + kappa_* + 0.25 (a + ib) per node, a = -1..4, b = -2..4 (42 lattice positions); stage 2: Q + 0.25 e^(i k pi/4), k = 1, 3, 5, 7, around each candidate
frozen.eta: g = (chi_22 / chi_22(real) in zk/chord) / eta of the chord2 plant at eta 1e-2, phi 0, wf 1.00, per position, L, P, alpha; W = [0.1/g, 10/g] cut to [1e-6, 0.2]; eta = the log-midpoints of 3 equal bins of W; if W is empty, eta = 0.2 when 0.1/g >= 0.2 (cap), else 1e-6 (floor); the same eta at every node
frozen.judge: #703's frozen judge, unchanged (pade_second_zero.evaluate: (a) m_DA <= 5, (b) d_P <= 0.03, (c') in zk/chord M_min = 23 and 0.1 <= chi_22 / chi_22(real) <= 10; (c'') by pade_second_zero.relocated and judge_reloc). (c'') is evaluated at a node only for a plant that passes (a) there, and only if control's R5 passed
frozen.nodes: every plant at wf 1.00; per position and group, the plants passing (a) and (c') at wf 1.00, smallest D first, run at 0.99 and then 1.01 until one passes (a) and (c') at all three nodes; apart, the same for (a) and (c''), smallest D'' first
frozen.located: a plant passes if (a) and (c') hold at all three nodes; a position passes for a group if one of its plants passes, and passes if it passes for some group; a lattice position is located if it passes, its 4 lattice neighbours (a +- 1, b), (a, b +- 1) exist in the lattice and pass for no group, and its 4 diagonal points (stage 2) pass for no group; otherwise no position is located and the region is not bounded by this rule, reported with the passing positions, |Q| and arg Q, and the lattice edges they touch. Apart, the same with (c'')
frozen.stage2: candidates: lattice positions that pass and whose 4 lattice neighbours exist and fail; their diagonal points run with every group, the eta rule and the node rule above
frozen.R6: pilot: 12 of #703's plants (seg(+1, +1), seg(0, 0), seg(-1, -1) x chord2, arc x alpha 0, beta - 1, eta 1e-1, phi 90) through this path at wf 1.00 against I703-mac/grid.jsonl: m_DA, M_min and the judge's (a), (b), (c') equal; d_P and chi_22 / chi_22(real) within 1e-12 relative; (c'')'s ratio within 1e-9 where both have it
frozen.R7: selftest: the second set's exact moments against mpmath.quad for (L, P) = (0.15, 4), (0.6, 4), (0.3, 2), (0.3, 6), alpha 0 and beta - 1, at a lattice and a diagonal position, k = 0, 7, 15, 22, 31: rel diff < 1e-40; the lattice curves with L = 0.3 equal pade_second_set.second_curve's bit for bit for #667's nine seg; the diagonal offsets 0.25 from their centre to 1e-50; the eta rule on planted g (7.79, 0.49, 1e8) gives a window whose eta g lie in [0.1, 10], the cap, and the floor
frozen.R8: pilot and ring: every plant at wf 1.00 has |chi_22 / chi_22(real) / (eta g) - 1| <= 1e-2, and every plant inside a window passes (c') at wf 1.00; the pilot checks it on Q = P0 + kappa_* + 0.25 (1 + i), (chord2, 0.3, 4), alpha 0, phi 0
frozen.J: pilot: J+ the real series judged through this path passes (a), (b), (c') at every node; J- the eta = 0 chord2 and arc plants at wf 1.00 fail the judge, M_min = 6 in their own kappa_* basis. #703's control (pade_second_zero.py control and its mutations) is rerun into OUTDIR first
frozen.gate: pilot runs only if control.json's controls pass; ring runs only if the pilot passes (R6, R8, J+, J-)
frozen.mutations: --selftest --mutate=secmom (alpha + 1e-10 in the exact moments): R7's moments fail; --selftest --mutate=len (L x (1 + 1e-6)): R7's curves fail; --selftest --mutate=window (g x 100 in the eta rule): R7's eta rule fails; pilot --mutate=len: R6 fails; pilot --mutate=window: R8 fails. Each exits 1
frozen.C1: #672's amended C1 on every plant scan; a failure is listed and the ring stage exits 1
frozen.context: per plant: the record of pade_second_zero.evaluate (the other 15 scans' chi_22 and M_min kept), the relocation; per position: |Q|, arg Q, g, the window; group-resolved maps; (b) and d_P. Reported, not judged
